> 第13章 妥协（第1页）
看着江流一脸狠厉的样子，潘端不免心里有些打鼓。难道，这小子真不怕死?但是他不怕，我可不能让弟弟跟他陪葬啊!不然我爹还不削死我。"好了!你把我弟弟放开!我让你走!"潘端无奈的说道。江流手上继续用力掐住潘候，一言不发。潘候手脚无力地胡乱挣扎，可是怎么都摆脱不了江流的控制。"江流!我认栽!你把我弟弟放了!""如果我弟弟死了，你也一样要陪葬的。我们又不是什么生死大仇，何必呢?"潘端极力的劝说道。"想让我放了潘候，除非你用武道之心发誓，之后不再找我麻烦。""不然的话，我拉着潘候陪葬就是了。反正我烂命一条。有潘候陪葬，怎么都不亏!"江流恶狠狠的说道。"好!我答应你!你先放开我弟弟。"潘端无奈的说道。"你先发誓!速度快点!不然我怕你弟弟坚持不了多久。""好!我答应你!"跟着就按照这方世界的誓言发了一遍。冥冥之中好像有一道亮光闪过。江流也吓了一跳!以为发誓就是权宜之计，没想到还真的有回应的。毕竟之前在蓝星的时候，发誓都是当笑话听的。看来在这方世界行事要小心了。江流松开掐住潘候的手，潘候立刻瘫软在地。那几个狗腿子立马上前扶起，又是激发气血，又是掐人中的。过了好一会，潘候咳嗽几声，呼吸终于顺畅了起来。潘侯一把推开围着的狗腿子，指着江流，喊道:"你很好，江流!你有种!今天不是你死，就是我亡!""住手!你还要闹到什么时候?"潘端喝道。"哥!今天不把他打服!那不是让人瞧不起?以后我们还怎么在落英帮混?"潘候气急的道。"好了!我刚才已经起誓!这事算揭过了!难道你想让我违背誓言?"潘端皱眉道。潘候听罢，随即一言不发地转身就走。潘端也带着狗腿子走了。江流回到住处小院。还是感觉自己实力太差了，意念一动，一道只有江流能看见的深蓝色光幕闪现辅助系统:姓名:江流境界:炼体（炼皮）猛虎拳（入门25100）炼药（入门37100）基础拳术（未入门510）五行拳（入门13100）今晚可以再练两遍五行拳，白天练六遍。一天最少可以练八遍，十多天就可以小成了。以后身体素质更好的话，应该还可以练多一遍。五行拳熟练度达到小成，境界应该可以到炼肉了吧!这一切还是未知。看来要尽快达到小成，不然就这哑巴系统，连个说明书都没有。江流郁闷的摇了摇头。收拾起心情开始演习五行拳，打完两遍，洗漱休息。翌日马师傅，一早就在学徒广场等着了。背着双手，一脸严肃，道:"到了的自觉站好!已经练了多天五行拳了!今天考核你们的熟练进度!"队伍站成七排，每排六个。倒是好数，一共四十二个学徒。各分堂的人数不一。暗鹰堂人数最少才六个。最多的是散鹰堂有十五个。江流在的捕鹰堂有九个。剩下的起鹰堂有十二个第一排，第一个的正是潘端。应该是个子比较矮，所以才排第一。江流暗搓搓的心想。潘端演练完毕，马师傅点评:"嗯!还可以!快入门了吧?"潘端拱手回道:"是的!马师傅!"马师傅摆了摆手。潘端回位，下一位继续演练。很快轮到潘候，只见潘候笨拙的演练着五行拳。江流一看，好家伙!离入门熟练度还差得很远。潘端好不容易一趟演练完毕。马师傅点评道:"你演练的是什么?那么不用心修炼，你来这里做什么?""下次再考核还是没入门？你可以回家去了，这里不留废物。""回马师傅，我会努力的!"潘候满脸不甘的说道。都怪该死的江流，不然我可以多修炼几次的。现在也不会给马师傅训斥了。王壮演练的时候。马师傅脸露满意之色，说道:"可以!你也快入门了!"到江流演练的时候，马师傅满眼笑意的说道:"果然没让我失望!继续保持!"江流一拱手道:"谨记马师傅教诲!"马师傅手一挥，道:"好了!各自演习吧!"说罢，转身走了。

> Chapter 13 Compromise (Page 1)
Seeing Jiang Liu's fierce look on his face, Pan Duan couldn't help but feel a little nervous. Is this kid really not afraid of death? But he is not afraid. I can't let my brother be buried with him! Otherwise, my father will kill me. "Okay! Let my brother go! I'll let you go!" Pan Duan said helplessly. Jiang Liu continued to pinch Pan Hou with his hands without saying a word. Pan Hou struggled wildly with his hands and feet, but he couldn't escape Jiang Liu's control. "Jiang Liu! I admit defeat! Let my brother go!" "If my brother dies, you will also be buried with him. We don't have a life-or-death feud, so why bother?" Pan Duan tried his best to persuade him. "You want me to let Pan Hou go, unless you swear with your martial arts heart that you won't trouble me anymore." "Otherwise, I will just take Pan Hou and bury him with him. Anyway, I will die. Having Pan Hou buried with me is not a loss at all!" Jiang Liu said fiercely. "Okay! I promise you! Let go of my brother first." Pan Duan said helplessly. "You swear first! Hurry up! Otherwise, I'm afraid your brother won't be able to hold on for long." "Okay! I promise you!" Then he swore the oath in accordance with the oath in this world. There seemed to be a bright light flashing through the darkness. Jiang Liu was also shocked! He thought that swearing was just a temporary solution, but he didn't expect that there was actually a response. After all, when I was at Blue Star, swearing was always a joke. It seems you have to be careful in this world. Jiang Liu let go of Pan Hou's hand, and Pan Hou immediately collapsed to the ground. Those losers immediately stepped forward to help him up, stimulating his energy and blood, and pinching him. After a while, Pan Hou coughed a few times and his breathing finally became smoother. Pan Hou pushed away the surrounding doglegs, pointed at Jiang Liu, and shouted: "You are very good, Jiang Liu! You have the guts! Either you die today or I die!" "Stop! How long are you going to make trouble?" Pan Duan shouted. "Brother! If you don't defeat him today! Wouldn't that make people look down upon? How can we still hang out with the Luoying Gang in the future?" Pan Hou said angrily. "Okay! I just swore an oath! This matter has been revealed! Do you want me to break my oath?" Pan Duan frowned. After hearing this, Pan Hou turned around and left without saying a word. Pan Duan also left with the dogleg. Jiang Liu returned to the small courtyard where he lived. I still feel that my strength is too weak. With a thought, a dark blue light curtain flashes that only Jiang Liu can see. Auxiliary system: Name: Jiang Liu Realm: Body refining (skin refining) Tiger Fist (entry 25100) Medicine refining (entry 37100) Basic boxing (510 uninitiated) Five Elements Fist (entry 13100) You can practice Five Elements Fist twice tonight and six times during the day. You can practice it at least eight times a day, and you can achieve it in more than ten days. If your physical fitness is better in the future, you should be able to practice it again. If you have reached a small level of proficiency in Five Elements Boxing, you should be able to refine meat! All this is still unknown. It seems that we need to achieve a small success as soon as possible, otherwise it will be a dumb system without even an instruction manual. Jiang Liu shook his head depressedly. I gathered my mood and started practicing Five Elements Boxing. After two times, I washed and rested. The next day, Master Ma was waiting at the Apprentice Square early in the morning. With his hands behind his back and a serious look on his face, he said: "When you arrive, stand still! I have been practicing Five Elements Boxing for many days! Today I will test your proficiency progress!" The team stood in seven rows, with six in each row. There are quite a few, forty-two apprentices in total. The number of people in each branch varies. There are at least six people in the Dark Eagle Hall. The most is Sanying Hall, which has fifteen. Jiang Liuzai's Eagle Catching Hall has nine. There are twelve first rows in the remaining Qi Ying Hall, and the first one is Pan Duan. He must be ranked first because he is relatively short. Jiang Liu thought secretly. After Pan Duan's drill, Master Ma commented: "Well! It's not bad! Let's get started soon."?" Pan Duan cupped his hands and replied: "Yes! Master Ma!" Master Ma waved his hand. Pan Duan returned to his position, and the next person continued to practice. Soon it was Pan Hou's turn, and he saw Pan Hou practicing the Five Elements Boxing clumsily. Jiang Liu took a look, what a guy! It's still far from entry-level proficiency. Pan Duan finally completed the practice. Master Ma commented: "What are you practicing? If you don't practice hard, what are you doing here?" "You will still fail to take the test next time?" You can go home, no waste is left here. "Hui Master Ma, I will work hard!" Pan Hou said with a face full of unwillingness. It's all the fault of the damn Jiang Liu, otherwise I could practice a few more times. Now I won't reprimand Master Ma. When Wang Zhuang was practicing, Master Ma showed a satisfied look on his face and said: "Okay! You can do it quickly too." Let’s get started!” When Jiang Liu was practicing, Master Ma said with a smile: “You really didn’t disappoint me! Keep up the good work!” Jiang Liu cupped his hands and said, “Remember Master Ma’s teachings!” Master Ma waved his hand and said, “Okay! Let’s practice each!” After that, he turned around and left.
